evidence.detail: The concrete R322 OutgoingPacket writes fixed C2S opcode 202 and no payload.
Exact-current C2S authority identifies opcode 202 as IDLE_LOGOUT_NOTICE, fixed length 0, STOCK_CLIENT_DIRECT.

A LocalLab session previously froze its C2S decoder exactly when opcode 202 was emitted after idle time because that fixed-zero schema was missing; adding the known framing restored the causal interpretation.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 idle logout/liveness notice transport; this is the packet implicated in the earlier LocalLab half-connected decoder pause.

evidence.detail: The concrete R322 OutgoingPacket writes fixed C2S opcode 210 followed by one i32 payload.
Exact-current C2S authority identifies opcode 210 as REGION_CHANGE_ACK with FIXED 4 / i32_be framing.
The protocol master classifies opcode 210 with UI/region lifecycle acknowledgements and explicitly separates it from gameplay services.
The concrete R322 OutgoingPacket writes fixed C2S opcode 121 and no payload.
Exact-current C2S authority identifies opcode 121 as REGION_LOADING_FINISHED_ACK, fixed length 0, STOCK_CLIENT_DIRECT.
LocalLab runtime captures opcode 121 repeatedly with loadingAck=true during region/bootstrap loading completion.
The concrete R322 OutgoingPacket writes fixed C2S opcode 0 and no payload bytes.
Exact-current C2S authority identifies opcode 0 as IDLE_KEEPALIVE, fixed length 0, STOCK_CLIENT_DIRECT.
LocalLab runtime captures repeated normal opcode-0 fixed-zero client packets during an otherwise healthy session, matching keepalive/liveness traffic rather than a gameplay action.
